parties: GACM Technologies Limited; Qualified Institutional Investors
headline: GACM Technologies Limited: Successfully Completion of Qualified Institutions Placement by the Company
sum: GACM Technologies Limited completed a Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) as announced on 21 August 2026. Details of institutional investors, pricing, and amount raised are not disclosed in available public sources.
implication: QIP completion signals capital-raise readiness and institutional confidence; review SEBI shareholder approval conditions and pricing band mechanics against final allotment terms.
detail: GACM Technologies Limited notified the NSE of completion of a QIP pursuant to Chapter VII of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018. The company issued a formal press release on 21 August 2026. Institutional investor composition, amount raised, share allotment details, and pricing are not publicly available in corroborating sources accessible at the time of this search.
